"certify such deletion to Client in writing"

"within thirty (30) days of such expiration or termination, return to Client all Client Content"

reasons: The Agreement contained no transition or data-return mechanic; the inserted Section 14a is a concise, self-contained clause that completes every preferred element: 6 months' assistance at then-current rates, 30-day return in a standard machine-readable format measured from expiry/termination, and deletion with written certification thereafter.

The "at Client's request" condition attaches only to transition assistance; the data return, deletion and certification duties remain unconditional, so the request condition does not swallow the mandatory return.

No unrelated term is altered: Sections 13 and 14 are untouched, the new paragraph is numbered 14a, and it uses existing defined terms (Client, TrueLink, Client Content, Client Proprietary Information) without introducing undefined terms or contradictions.
The qualifier "reasonable" before transition assistance is a customary softener that does not defeat the duty or its duration; it is a rationale-level note rather than a deviation.
